faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the product and billing.
faq_a1: Yes! Job search and matching is 100% free forever. You only pay for cover letter generation and CV correction services.
faq_a2: Our CV correction is a one-time service. We professionally format your CV to German standards, correct language errors, and optimize it for ATS systems. Once corrected, you can update and use it unlimited times.
faq_a3: You can upgrade or downgrade your plan anytime. If you have remaining cover letters from a Standard pack, they'll remain valid when you switch.
faq_a4: We support 50+ languages. You can write your CV and cover letters in any language, and we'll translate and format them to professional German standards.
faq_a5: For the Standard pack (30 letters), your credits are valid for 90 days. Unlimited monthly plans renew each month. Pay-as-you-go letters never expire.
faq_q6: What if I need help with my application?
faq_a6: We offer comprehensive support through our help center, live chat, and email support. Our team is here to help you succeed in your German job search journey.

home_why_founded_text1: As international professionals in Germany ourselves, we experienced firsthand the frustration of spending hours formatting CVs according to German standards, writing cover letters from scratch for each application, and navigating job boards in a foreign language. We knew there had to be a better way.
home_why_founded_text2: Applit was born from our own pain points. We built the tool we wished existed when we were job hunting - one that removes language barriers, automates the tedious formatting work, and lets talented professionals focus on what matters: landing their dream job in Germany.
